name: Cleanuparr
short_desc: Removes stalled, failed-import and orphaned downloads from the *arr queues and retriggers searches
author: Cleanuparr
description: Cleanuparr is a download manager for the Servarr ecosystem. It strikes and removes downloads that are stalled, stuck in metadata, failing to import, or unreasonably slow, then triggers a replacement search in Sonarr/Radarr so the queue never silently blocks new grabs. It also blocks known-malicious files, cleans up torrents past a seeding threshold, and finds orphaned files that no *arr references and no torrent claims. Configured entirely through its own web UI; point it at Sonarr, Radarr and Transmission after install.
